name: Lauki sabzi (bottle gourd cooked with onion and tomato)

source.name: Swasthi's Recipes (indianhealthyrecipes.com)
source.license: Ingredient amounts as listed in the cited recipe, converted to grams; nutrients composed from USDA FoodData Central (CC0)

notes: Serves 2 to 3. Bottle gourd 450 g as listed (USDA calabash gourd). Weights: 1/2 cup chopped onion = 80 g, 1 cup chopped tomato = 180 g, 1 tsp ginger = 3 g (ginger chosen over garlic), 1 green chilli = 5 g, 2 tbsp oil = 27 g, salt 5/8 tsp = 3.75 g, Kashmiri chilli powder 5/8 tsp = 1.6 g, coriander powder 3/4 tsp = 1.4 g (as coriander seed), garam masala 1/2 tsp as curry powder, fennel powder 1/2 tsp as fennel seed, coriander leaves 2 tbsp = 2 g. Curry leaves left out (not in catalog). Water 1/2 to 2/3 cup taken as 140 g; assumed ~120 g of it and ~10% of vegetable weight cook off. A katori or bowl is taken as 1 cup, as everywhere in the catalog.
